name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.Exotic.rank_support_mono
title: Rank-metric support (and rank weight) does not grow under base-field linear maps
statement: Let K / F be a field extension, e in K^N and H an N x n matrix over F. The F-span of the entries of e H is contained in the F-span of the entries of e, and so its F-dimension (the rank weight) is at most that of e. Hence in the rank metric any F-linear evaluation (via the coordinate gadget of K over F) has no noise growth, in contrast with the Hamming-metric sparse-preimage lemma.
